title: CategoryData - Data API
description: Represents a logical grouping of Solution records.

CategoryNodeId.description: ID of the CategoryNode associated with the solution.

IsDeleted.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

RelatedSobjectId.description: ID of the solution related to the category.

special_access_rules: Customer Portal users can't access this object.
usage:
This object allows you to assign one or more categories to a Solution. It is an intermediate data table with two foreign keys that defines the relationship between a CategoryNode and a Solution record. This is a many-to-many relationship, so there can be multiple rows returned with a CategoryNodeId. A Solution can be associated with multiple categories.
